title: Chapter 1470
text:
It was the familiar Stream of Light Tunnel, and the familiar hazy feeling …

After an unknown amount of time, Han Xiao's mind suddenly shook, and he regained consciousness.

Han Xiao's vision suddenly opened up. As far as the eye could see, it was still the familiar scene of the First Sanctum. The white world was boundless, and countless gentle light clusters floated in it, storing the Information Form collections of Iterations one after another.

"It's still the same blurry feeling, but it's a little lighter than last time …"

Han Xiao was not unfamiliar with this feeling. After all, he had been here many times and was already a regular.

He looked down at the back of his hand. The Sanctum authority mark was shining brightly, one level higher than last time.

"Let's revive those unlucky bastards first."

Han Xiao did not delay and skillfully sacrificed the mediums of the various dead Beyond Grade As to activate the Sanctum Revival function.

Very soon, rays of light appeared out of thin air and gathered from all directions, condensing into a Sanctum Revival mark that floated in front of Han Xiao.

Han Xiao pointed with his finger, and the Sanctum Revival mark seemed to turn into liquid, flowing along his finger and freezing on the back of his hand, turning into a complicated tattoo.

He probed with his mind and checked the targets of the revival, confirming that all the famous people on the Soul Comfort Monument were inside.

After doing this, Han Xiao exhaled softly, calmed down, summoned the Sanctum's message board, and looked at it.

The authority of the First Sanctum had increased again, and more content appeared on the message board than last time. Han Xiao compared it according to his memory, and when he saw the fifth last paragraph of the Celestial Star Alliance, he focused and read it carefully.

The last four paragraphs were where most of the content was missing. He had read it twice before and only obtained two pieces of slightly valuable information. One was the 'Information Form Stripping Plan' mentioned in the fourth last paragraph, and the other was the last paragraph, which indicated the continuation of the previous Iteration's plan and mentioned some kind of 'unknown device' and 'control valve'.

This time, Han Xiao found that some of the missing content in the last four messages had been filled in. Among them, there was some information that caught his attention in the second and last paragraphs.

The conversion plan failed, but the principle has been proven to be feasible. The reason for the failure is the lack of a key medium of truth, and the connection cannot be established. Next time, this will need to be perfected … In addition, the Information Materialization device has been completed and loaded into the template. There is a possibility that information will be mutated during the process of creating the Information Materialization device, and it will appear in the subsequent Information Materialization in an unknown form as a "distorted" form …] — The penultimate message.

[… The current True Form medium is not enough to complete the previous iteration's transformation plan. We need a deeper level of connection to build a stable bridge … We have decided to add a control valve for the Information Materialization device to reduce the processing cost of the Information Materialization device when it goes berserk …] — The last part of the message.

"Oh, this …"

Han Xiao's eyes flashed.

The penultimate message was the 'previous iteration' mentioned in the penultimate message. From the current content, it could be seen that the latter had inherited the former's plan.

The 'unknown device' and 'control valve' mentioned in the penultimate message had been unlocked at this time. They were the 'Information Materialization device' created in the penultimate message.

In addition, these two messages threw out a new concept, 'True Form'. Han Xiao was secretly surprised. With his current level, there were very few things that he did not understand at the technological level. This was actually the first time he had seen this term.

Han Xiao tried to use the index function of the Sanctum authority to search for this keyword, but the Sanctum mark did not react. Generally speaking, only a precise search for a single Iteration or civilization name could activate the index function.

"Looks like I'll have to continue grinding for authority and unlock the civilization name of these last four messages."

Han Xiao nodded to himself. The civilization name mentioned in the last four messages was still empty, and he did not have the authority to check it.

After memorizing this information in his heart, Han Xiao closed the message board and began to search for technical information in the First Sanctum.

Although he had not finished studying all the information in his hands and did not lack technology, since he was already here …

After the Sanctum authority increased, the upper limit of his memory capacity also increased. After a long time, Han Xiao finally filled up the capacity this time and returned with a full load. He did not stay any longer and opened the Sanctum passage to leave.

After passing through the Stream of Light Tunnel again, Han Xiao's body suddenly became light, and he returned to the main universe. The Sanctum light door behind him disappeared.

Han Xiao opened his communicator and took a look. Only thirty days had passed.

"The time flow is getting closer and closer. Next time, it'll probably only take twenty days." Han Xiao's eyes lit up.

The Sanctum message board seemed to be universal, and it was the same for every Sanctum. Therefore, he only needed to focus his firepower on one of the Sanctums. If he focused on all the Sanctums, it would take many years.

Han Xiao thought for a while, changed into the King, and teleported to the main planet of the Supers Holy Land. He flew to the huge square where all the Beyond Grade A statues were placed.

At this time, the square was bustling with activity, and there was an endless stream of pedestrians. They were all Supers who had gathered from all over the world. When they saw Han Xiao arrive, they were stunned for a moment before being overjoyed.

"Look, it's Black Star!"

"It's actually a real person!"

"I'm your admirer. Can you give me an autograph …"

Many passersby were excited. They swarmed over like crazy fans.

Among the Supers, Black Star was almost the idol of the entire world. At least eight out of ten Supers were his admirers. He was no different from a great man.

Han Xiao smiled at the crowd and waved his hand. A gentle breeze blew, and an invisible force field rotated and spread out, covering an area like a transparent barrier, blocking all the pedestrians.

The pedestrians further away also heard the wind and came over. There was a sea of people outside the barrier, and soon, there were layers and layers of people. They looked at Han Xiao curiously, guessing the purpose of his appearance.

Han Xiao did not explain anything and just activated the Sanctum Revival mark. Rays of light surged and condensed into balls of light, gradually transforming into the bodies of the dead Beyond Grade As.

The reason why he deliberately showed his divinity in front of the public was to let the public see the actual scene of the Sanctum Revival and increase the attraction of the Supers Holy Land. This was the plan that had been decided during the meeting a few months ago. In the future, every Sanctum Revival would be carried out publicly.

Before farming the Sanctum authority, Han Xiao planned to revive these unlucky people first. On one hand, he wanted them to return earlier and fulfill his promise.

On the other hand, he wanted the three Universal Civilizations and the other organizations to see that the time he spent in the Sanctum had been shortened, telling them that he could return at any time … Although these people might not have any other thoughts, Han Xiao felt that it was best to avoid this possibility, in case these advanced civilizations felt that he had disappeared for too long and wanted to cause trouble again.

Very soon, the light in the square condensed, and under everyone's gazes, the dead Beyond Grade As were revived. Confusion remained on their faces, and they only gradually regained their senses after a while.

"Haha, I'm alive again. Praise Black Star!"

"Where is this? Why haven't I seen it before?"

"What era is it now? Is the World Tree War over?"

The group of revivors looked around curiously. In the end, their gazes landed on Han Xiao.

"Alright, the war is over. We won. You can ask Aurora and the others about the details."

Han Xiao waved his hand nonchalantly. This was not the first time these people had revived, and the good thing was that he did not need to explain the situation from the beginning.

He turned to look at Dylan and said, "I've fulfilled my promise and let you regain your freedom. You'd better keep a low profile in the future. Otherwise, if others want to kill you again, I won't stop them."

Dylan's face twitched, and he was speechless.

Regaining his freedom should have been a happy thing, but Dillon felt guilty.

When he was an Underworld Hero Spirit, he did not have to worry about anything, so he was even more unrestrained when he spoke. He could scold whoever he wanted, and he offended many people.

Others could not be bothered to argue with a 'dead person' like him, but now that he was alive, if others came to settle the score, even if they had to suffer …

For some reason, Dylan felt a little reluctant to be an Underworld Hero Spirit …

Han Xiao did not say much to the others. He turned around and teleported, disappearing from the spot. Without the force field barrier, countless pedestrians swarmed over. These revivors did not understand the situation and were almost drowned in the sea of people. They quickly rose into the sky and left.

Halfway through the flight, Aurora, who had already noticed the commotion, rushed over with a group of Beyond Grade As who had stayed behind on the main planet to welcome the revivors.

"Congratulations on your revival. Come with us and I'll explain the situation to you," Aurora said.

Ever since she was elected as the second-in-command of the Supers Holy Land, she had been maintaining her mature appearance, as if this would give her some 'dignity'. However, in the eyes of the Beyond Grade As who had a preconceived impression of her, she was still cute. Even if Aurora purposely put on a dignified and elegant posture, it did not have any deterrence at all.

The revivors nodded and followed Aurora, flying toward the core building of the Supers Holy Land.

Just as Dylan was about to follow, he suddenly felt a hot and vigorous blood aura coming from the side. Two thick and elastic chest muscles clamped over and bit his arm like a big mouth. At the same time, his shoulder was held by someone, and waves of force came from it, grabbing him tightly, not allowing him to move.

Dylan turned around and saw Sierron appear beside him. He put his arm around his shoulder and put his arm around his shoulder. The huge basin came over, and there was a malicious smile on his rough face.

"Yo, you're finally alive. Come over here, we have a bunch of guys who want to have a good chat with you."

Dylan turned his head stiffly and saw a group of Beyond Grade As staring at him with playful eyes. There was no lack of peak Beyond Grade As among them.

"Gulp …"

Dylan swallowed his saliva, and cold sweat broke out on his back.

As the saying went, it was easy to go from frugal to extravagant, but difficult to go from extravagant to frugal. At this moment, Dylan realized that it was indeed more 'comfortable' to be a Hero Spirit …

…

Han Xiao only appeared for a short while. After completing the Sanctum Revival, he immediately opened the Sanctum and started the operation to farm his authority.

Now that the matters of the Supers Holy Land were under the jurisdiction of Aurora and the Elders Committee, and the external environment was very stable, his disappearance did not have much of an impact.

As the days passed, it was finally time for Kasuyi to set off. Most of the Beyond Grade As respected this old brother of theirs, and on the day he left, they all came to send him off.

After the battle of the World Tree, most of them had become comrades, and their relationship was much better than before. Kasuyi, who was kind to others, was quite popular.

At the dock of the Supers Holy Land, long-distance spaceships that contained all kinds of the highest technology were docked in orbit. The hatch opened, and Kasuyi and Oathkeeper had already packed their things. They stood in front of the gangway and said goodbye to everyone.

"The unexplored universe is filled with unknown dangers. You two must be careful," Aurora reminded on behalf of everyone.

Kasuyi smiled. "It's fine. Anyway, there's Black Star to back us up … Haha, just kidding. With our abilities, we won't fall into danger so easily."

"Once you guys leave, you probably won't be back for a long time. There's no news of you. Sigh … I won't be able to find you to play cards in the future." Kant was a little sad.

"It's fine. Our Supers Holy Land doesn't have much else, but we have plenty of poker friends." Kasuyi shook his head and smiled.

At this moment, Manison walked forward and patted Kasuyi's shoulder. He did not say much and said concisely, "Goodbye, old friend. Have a safe journey."

"Thank you. I wish you a smooth seclusion." Kasuyi stopped smiling and nodded.

Excluding Black Star, among everyone, his relationship with Manison was actually the best. The two of them had known each other for hundreds of years and were old acquaintances. You know my background, and I know yours. Their relationship was not ordinary.

Most of the people around Kasuyi were Beyond Grade As of the current era. On the other side, Oathkeeper was surrounded by the first batch of revived Primordial Ones of the Holy Covenant organization.

"Back then, when we made the Holy Covenant together, our companions died one after another. Only you persevered until now. We didn't expect you to really complete this cause."

"It's been hard on you all these years. If not for you, we would still be in hibernation."

"Although you didn't show off in the era when we were active, only now do we know that you might be the best among us."

The Primordial Ones were filled with emotions.

Oathkeeper waved his hand expressionlessly. "Let's not talk about the past. I'm just carrying out the promise back then. There's nothing worth praising … Unfortunately, although we really achieved our wish and successfully revived in the future, the era no longer belongs to us."

Beiger sighed and said with a reluctant tone, "Sigh, no matter what, we're always grateful for what you did. When you miss us, take a look at the Primordial Card Deck we gave you. This is the first-generation limited edition card that we 'kindly' got from the headquarters of the Wayne Card distribution group …"

"I'll keep it well." Oathkeeper was speechless, but an imperceptible smile still appeared on his usually serious face.

After bidding farewell for a while, they finally finished saying what they needed to say. Kasuyi and Oathkeeper looked at each other.

"Let's go."

The two of them nodded to everyone, turned around, and boarded the spaceship.

Hum!

Everyone watched as the spaceship slowly started, glided along the track, took off, and drove into space. It suddenly accelerated and disappeared into the depths of the galaxy, leaving behind a bright trail of flames.

Manison retracted his gaze, turned around, and left without saying goodbye.

He decided to enter a long-term seclusion from today onwards. He would be isolated from the world, learn technology down-to-earth, and focus on scientific research.

Compared to taking shortcuts, he still preferred to rely on his own wisdom. It had never changed.

…

At the same time, in the Arcane Church, Temple of Ten Thousand Gods.

A fleet of long-distance voyages was ready to set off.

"Your Excellency Wuornos, have you decided? Are you really going to the unexplored universe?"

A group of priests gathered around him with a complicated expression.

"I've already discovered that the key to opening the path ahead is hidden in the depths of the galaxy."

Wuornos looked at the galaxy with a deep gaze.

Just a few months ago, he had finally unearthed his hidden perception and sensed the location of the Beyonder's Vestige in the galaxy. It was like the morning star, guiding the way from afar.

In the end, he decided to follow his intuition and leave the explored universe to head to the unknown area to find an opportunity to enter the Transcendent Grade.

"In that case, we respect your choice … The Pope asked us to specially pass on a message. He said that he hopes that when you return, you can become the first direct descendant Transcendent."

"Tell him that he will get what he wants."

Wuornos replied calmly and walked into the spaceship.

The next moment, the Arcane Church's fleet slowly set sail, heading toward the unknown path.
